com.vector.cfg.workflow.groovy.update.project

Interface IFilePreprocessingProjectApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @ThreadSafe
public interface IFilePreprocessingProjectApi
    Allows to start only the file preprocessing part of the Update Workflow without the project update.

      • fileSet

        @PublishedMethod
<T> T fileSet(@VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IFileSetApi.class)
                                groovy.lang.Closure<T> code)
        modifies the existing file set. Call this method only in case there is only one file set available. (e.g. for non variant projects). 
         
        fileSet(){
            inputFiles {
                clear()
            }
        }

      • getAvailableFileSets

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IFileSet> getAvailableFileSets()
        Gets a list of all available IFileSet.
        Use getAvailableFileSets() to get a list with all available file sets. For non-Variant projects, only one file set is available.
        Returns:
        List of all IFileSet

      • getFileSetByName

        @PublishedMethod
IFileSet getFileSetByName(java.lang.String name)
        Get the IFileSet with the given name.
        Use getFileSetByName(String) to get the file set with the given name. This method can be used to get the according file set of one specific variant.

        throws WorkflowExecutionException if no IFileSet with the given name was found.
        Parameters:
        name - the name
        Returns:
        the file set by name

      • selectiveUpdate

        @PublishedMethod
void selectiveUpdate(boolean value)
        Configuration of the selective update setting.

   selectiveUpdate(false)
  }

      • updateSettings

        @PublishedMethod
void updateSettings(@VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IUpdateApi.IUpdateSettingsApi.class)
                                      groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        Configuration of common update settings.

        Usage example to set some update settings: 

         
 update(Paths.get("MyProject.dpa")){
   updateSettings{
     updateMode = ECUC_ONLY
     uuidUsageInStandardConfigurationEnabled = false
   }
 }
